title: Endorsement Manual: Mid-Term Limit Changes on Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)
content:
Mid-term changes of the excess limits of an **Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)** policy are made by endorsement under this rule.

## Clauses in force

1. A mid-term endorsement is a limit increase or a limit decrease and is processed only on a policy whose status is pending effective or active. The status is read from the policy record of the policy being endorsed at the time the endorsement is processed; an expired or cancelled policy is not endorsed.
2. The minimum earned premium does not apply to a mid-term decrease, and the policy fee is unchanged.

## Retired clause

> The policy as endorsed is re-rated for the full term, and the change in the full-term premium multiplied by the days from the endorsement effective date to the term end divided by the days from the term start to the term end, rounded to the cent, is booked as an endorsement premium item for an increase or an endorsement credit of the term premium item for a decrease, with the surplus lines tax and stamping fee on that amount booked or credited at the policy's recorded rates.

This clause is **no longer in force** as written. It is superseded by the current basis: a to-value limit increase is booked on the current basis for such increases; for a decrease and for every other endorsement the policy as endorsed is re-rated for the full term, and the change in the full-term premium multiplied by the days from the endorsement effective date to the term end divided by the days from the term start to the term end, rounded to the cent, is booked as an endorsement premium item for an increase or an endorsement credit of the term premium item for a decrease, with the surplus lines tax and stamping fee on that amount booked or credited at the policy's recorded rates.

## Pro rata change, worked (hypothetical figures)

A decrease effective with 73 days left in a 365-day term, where the re-rated full-term premium is 800.00 lower: the credit of the term premium item is 800.00 multiplied by 73 and divided by 365, that is 160.00, and the surplus lines tax and stamping fee on 160.00 are credited at the policy's recorded rates. No minimum earned premium is applied to the decrease, and the policy fee stays as booked.

superseded_clauses: The policy as endorsed is re-rated for the full term, and the change in the full-term premium multiplied by the days from the endorsement effective date to term_end divided by the days from term_start to term_end, rounded to the cent, is booked as an ENDORSEMENT_PREMIUM item for an increase or an ENDORSEMENT credit of the TERM_PREMIUM item for a decrease, with the surplus lines tax and stamping fee on that amount booked or credited at the policy's recorded rates.
